info.title: CBE/BCE/KBO API Documentation
info.description:
Access to the Belgian Company Registry (CBE/BCE/KBO - Crossroads Bank for Enterprises). Search and retrieve official data about companies, self-employed individuals, and organizations registered in Belgium.

This API is provided by [MaFacturation](https://mafacturation.be), a Belgian invoicing software for freelancers and small businesses.

### What You Can Access

- Company identification (BCE number, names, legal form)
- All establishment addresses and contact details
- NACE activity codes with descriptions
- Juridical situations and registration status
- Search by name, BCE number, or address components

### Multi-Language Support

All endpoints support French, Dutch, and German via the `lang` parameter or HTTP headers:
- `?lang=fr` or `Accept-Language: fr`
- `?lang=nl` or `Accept-Language: nl`
- `?lang=de` or `Accept-Language: de`

Language affects company names, legal forms, activity descriptions, and other localized fields.

### Data Source

Synchronized with official BCE Open Data. Data includes all registered Belgian companies with their headquarters and branch establishments.

get.description:
Returns the hierarchical structure of NACE codes organized by levels:
- Level 1: 01, 02, 03... (2 digits)
- Level 2: 011, 012, 013... (3 digits)
- Level 3: 0111, 0112, 0113... (4 digits)
- Level 4: 01110, 01120... (5 digits)
- Level 5: 0111001, 0111002... (7+ digits)

The version parameter works cumulatively:
- 2003: Returns only NACE 2003 codes
- 2008: Returns NACE 2003 + 2008 codes (cumulative)
- 2025: Returns NACE 2003 + 2008 + 2025 codes (cumulative)

When duplicate codes exist across versions, the most recent version takes precedence.

parameters.name: nace_version
parameters.description: NACE version to retrieve. Works cumulatively — includes all versions up to the specified one. Defaults to 2025.

X-Data-Freshness.description: Freshness tier of the company data: `monthly` (free plan, frozen snapshot) or `live` (paid plan, daily updates).

X-Data-As-Of.description: Date the served data reflects (YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when not yet known.

get.description:
Returns a specific NACE code with its complete hierarchy path:
its details, all parent codes up to the root, and all direct children.

The version parameter works cumulatively like the hierarchy endpoint.
get.summary: Get a NACE code with its hierarchy

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of companies associated with a NACE activity code,
including all sub-codes. For example, querying `62` returns companies with
`620`, `6201`, `62010`, etc.

`nace_version` is required because the same code can describe completely different
activities across versions — e.g. `01130` means "fruit growing" in Nace2003 but
"vegetables" in Nace2008.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The NACE activity code. All sub-codes are included automatically.

parameters.name: nace_version
parameters.description: NACE version (2003, 2008, 2025). Required — the same code can mean different activities across versions.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

X-Data-Freshness.description: Freshness tier of the company data: `monthly` (free plan, frozen snapshot) or `live` (paid plan, daily updates).

X-Data-As-Of.description: Date the served data reflects (YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when not yet known.

get.description:
Searches for Belgian companies using either a company name or postal code.
Name searches use full-text search on company denominations and BCE numbers.
Postal code searches return all companies in that postal code area.
At least one of the parameters must be provided, if both are provided, results are filtered by both.
get.summary: Search for companies by name or postal code

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

X-Data-Freshness.description: Freshness tier of the company data: `monthly` (free plan, frozen snapshot) or `live` (paid plan, daily updates).

X-Data-As-Of.description: Date the served data reflects (YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when not yet known.

400.description: If no search parameters are provided, return error

message.const: Please provide either a company name or a postal code to search.

one must be provided. Results are filtered by the combination of provided parameters.

get.description:
Retrieves detailed information about a specific Belgian company using its BCE (Banque-Carrefour des Entreprises) number.
The BCE number can be provided in various formats (with or without dots, spaces, or the 'BE' prefix).
get.summary: Get company information by BCE number

X-Data-Freshness.description: Freshness tier of the company data: `monthly` (free plan, frozen snapshot) or `live` (paid plan, daily updates).

X-Data-As-Of.description: Date the served data reflects (YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when not yet known.

get.description:
Retrieves a single Belgian establishment by its establishment number. This
is the only way to reach **branches** (succursales): they carry a
`9.xxx.xxx.xxx` number, are not attached to any enterprise, and therefore
never appear in a company's `establishments` list nor in search results.
Regular establishment units (`2.xxx.xxx.xxx`) are also resolvable here.
The number can be provided in various formats (with or without dots, spaces,
or the 'BE' prefix).
get.summary: Get establishment information by establishment number

X-Data-Freshness.description: Freshness tier of the company data: `monthly` (free plan, frozen snapshot) or `live` (paid plan, daily updates).

X-Data-As-Of.description: Date the served data reflects (YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when not yet known.

start_date.description: Date the establishment unit (or branch) was created (BCE StartDate).

extra_info.description: Free-form address complement (floor, "Résidence X"…), null when absent.

type_of_address.description:
Type of the establishment address (BCE/KBO TypeOfAddress).
In practice the BCE Open Data only emits two values here:
 - `establishment_unit` (BAET): the address of an establishment unit
   belonging to a Belgian enterprise (the vast majority of records).
 - `branch` (ABBR): the address of a branch (succursale). These carry a
   9.xxx.xxx.xxx number in `establishment_number` and are attached to
   their parent enterprise (BCE branch.csv EnterpriseNumber), so they
   appear in that company's `establishments` list like any other unit.
`oldest_active_establishment` (OBAD) is defined by BCE but never present
in the current Open Data, so it is not returned. The registered office
(REGO) is exposed on the company `address` object, not here.

date_striking_off.description: Date the address was struck off (radiée), null if still active

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
